catalog.label: KV cache share of free GPU memory
catalog.help: Share of the GPU memory that is still free after the weights are loaded and a profiling pass has run, which the KV cache may claim. Default 0.9; must stay below 1.

catalog.label: KV cache dtype
catalog.help: Storage type of the KV cache: auto follows the checkpoint, fp8 about halves the cache for a small accuracy risk, nvfp4 needs a checkpoint prepared for it (not listed as supported on sm_120).

catalog.label: KV cache token cap
catalog.help: Upper bound on the tokens held in the KV cache. If the free-memory fraction allows fewer, the smaller value wins.

catalog.label: KV cache size cap (GiB per GPU)
catalog.help: Upper bound on the GPU memory each GPU gives the KV cache, in GiB; the smaller of this and the fraction-based size is used. 0 or unset means no cap.

catalog.label: KV host offload (GiB per GPU)
catalog.help: Host RAM, per GPU worker, that evicted KV blocks are copied to so they can be reused without recomputing. Unset or 0 turns offloading off.

catalog.label: KV block size (tokens)
catalog.help: Tokens stored in one KV cache block. Must be a power of two greater than 1; the default is 32.

catalog.label: Attention window per layer
catalog.help: Sliding-window sizes in tokens, repeated across the layers, for models with windowed attention. Leave unset unless you know the model's layer pattern.

catalog.label: Recurrent-state dtype
catalog.help: Data type of the recurrent state of Mamba and linear-attention layers in hybrid models; auto follows the model config.

catalog.label: Tensor parallel size
catalog.help: Split every layer across this many GPUs. Without NVLink the GPUs exchange data over PCIe on every layer; NVIDIA's own RTX PRO 6000 benchmarks used pipeline parallelism instead.

catalog.label: Pipeline parallel size
catalog.help: Split the model into this many consecutive stages, one per GPU. Needs less GPU-to-GPU traffic than tensor parallelism, but cannot be combined with MTP or EAGLE-3 speculation.

catalog.label: Context parallel size
catalog.help: Spread very long prompts over several GPUs. Multiplies the number of GPUs needed.

catalog.label: MoE expert parallel size
catalog.help: For mixture-of-experts models: how many GPUs the experts are spread over. Must divide the tensor-parallel size; leave unset for dense models.

catalog.label: MoE tensor parallel size
catalog.help: For MoE models: how many GPUs each expert's weights are sliced across. The product with the expert and cluster sizes must equal the tensor-parallel size.

catalog.label: MoE cluster parallel size
catalog.help: Expert cluster parallelism, an extra grouping inside the expert split. Only with expert parallel size 1.

catalog.label: Attention data parallel
catalog.help: Run the attention layers data-parallel (every GPU serves different requests) while the rest stays tensor-parallel. Mostly useful for large MoE models under heavy load.

catalog.label: All-reduce strategy
catalog.help: How GPUs sum partial results after each layer. AUTO lets the engine choose; NCCL is the plain choice that always works.

catalog.label: Worker orchestrator
catalog.help: How the server launches and talks to its GPU worker processes. Unset uses MPI; rpc avoids MPI. Prototype in 1.2.1 (the image has no Ray, so the ray choice is left out).

catalog.label: Disable GPU peer-to-peer (NCCL)
catalog.help: Sets NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 so GPUs stop copying directly to each other and go through host memory. Only for multi-GPU launches that hang because direct copies do not work.

catalog.label: Max sequence length
catalog.help: Longest request (prompt plus answer) in tokens. Unset reads it from the model config; a larger value than the model supports is cut down by the engine.

catalog.label: Max beam width
catalog.help: Largest beam-search width a request may use. Keep 1 unless you serve beam search; larger values cost memory.

catalog.label: Media I/O kwargs (JSON)
catalog.help: Options for decoding images, video and audio, as a JSON object (for example {"image": {...}}). Multimodal models only.

catalog.label: Model revision
catalog.help: Branch, tag or commit of the model in the Hugging Face cache. Pin it: an unpinned main can change between restarts.

catalog.label: Tokenizer override
catalog.help: Tokenizer repository or path if it differs from the model's. It must already be in the local Hugging Face cache: the engine runs offline.

catalog.label: Tokenizer mode
catalog.help: auto uses the fast tokenizer when there is one; slow forces the Python implementation.

catalog.label: Custom tokenizer
catalog.help: A built-in tokenizer implementation by alias (deepseek_v32). Python import paths are not accepted here because they would run arbitrary code.

catalog.label: Trust remote code
catalog.help: Let Hugging Face transformers run Python code shipped with the model repository. Only for repositories you have reviewed.

catalog.label: MoE kernel backend
catalog.help: Kernel family for mixture-of-experts layers. CUTLASS is the default; the image's code raises an error for TRTLLM on sm_120, and the DEEPGEMM, CUTEDSL and WIDEEP paths check for sm_100/103.

catalog.label: MoE chunk size (tokens)
catalog.help: If set, MoE layers process at most this many tokens at a time and loop over larger batches, trading speed for lower peak memory.

catalog.label: NVFP4 GEMM backends
catalog.help: Kernel backends the engine may pick from for NVFP4 matrix multiplies (cutlass, cublaslt, cutedsl, cuda_core). cutedsl is left out by default to keep start-up short.

catalog.label: Max batch size
catalog.help: Most requests handled in one step. Default 2048; it also bounds the CUDA graph batch sizes.

catalog.label: Max tokens per step
catalog.help: Most tokens processed in one step, summed over all requests. It also sizes the working memory reserved at start-up. Default 8192.

catalog.label: Chunked prefill
catalog.help: Split long prompts into chunks so the decode steps of other requests are not starved.

catalog.label: KV block reuse (prefix caching)
catalog.help: Reuse KV blocks between requests that share a prompt prefix (system prompts, agent loops). On by default; the engine switches it off itself for the FlashInfer attention backend.

catalog.label: Partial block reuse
catalog.help: Also reuse a block when only some of its tokens match a cached prefix. On by default; only matters when block reuse is on.

catalog.label: Capacity policy
catalog.help: How requests are admitted when the KV cache runs short: GUARANTEED_NO_EVICT (the default) admits only what can finish, MAX_UTILIZATION packs more and may pause requests, STATIC_BATCH is a legacy mode.

catalog.label: Chunking policy
catalog.help: How chunked prefill shares each step between prompts: FIRST_COME_FIRST_SERVED (the default when chunking is on) or EQUAL_PROGRESS.

catalog.label: Disable overlap scheduler
catalog.help: Turn off overlapping CPU scheduling with GPU work. It is on by default for speed; switch it off only to debug.

catalog.label: Stream interval (steps)
catalog.help: Send a streamed chunk every N steps instead of every step. Larger values cut CPU overhead at high concurrency but make streaming less smooth.

catalog.label: Batch wait (ms)
catalog.help: Wait up to this long for a full batch before running a step. 0 never waits. Prototype.

catalog.label: Batch wait (steps)
catalog.help: Wait up to this many steps to gather new requests before running a batch. 0 never waits. Prototype.

catalog.label: Batch wait token threshold
catalog.help: Hold requests back until the waiting tokens reach this share of max_num_tokens. 0 turns it off. Prototype.

catalog.label: Post-processing workers
catalog.help: Extra processes that turn raw results into OpenAI-format responses (detokenizing). 0 does it inside the server process; raise it for high streaming concurrency.

catalog.label: Sampler
catalog.help: auto, TorchSampler or TRTLLMSampler. auto uses TorchSampler unless beam search is requested; TRTLLMSampler cannot be combined with MTP or EAGLE-3.

catalog.label: Tool-call parser
catalog.help: Parser for the model's tool-call format. Only the six dialects the image ships are available; other model families cannot return structured tool calls.

catalog.label: Reasoning parser
catalog.help: Splits the model's thinking from its answer into reasoning_content. deepseek-r1, qwen3 and nano-v3 all expect <think> ... </think> markers.

catalog.label: Chat template
catalog.help: A Jinja chat template: an absolute file path inside the container, or the template text itself (it must contain braces or a newline, otherwise it is read as a file name).

catalog.label: Structured output backend
catalog.help: Engine for JSON-schema and grammar-constrained output: xgrammar or llguidance. Unset turns structured output off.

catalog.label: CUDA graphs
catalog.help: Replay recorded GPU work for decode steps. On by default (batch sizes up to 128); each graph can take up to about 200 MB. Off removes them, which costs decode speed.

catalog.label: CUDA graph max batch
catalog.help: Largest batch size to record a CUDA graph for; the sizes below it are generated. 0 or unset means 128. Do not combine with explicit batch sizes.

catalog.label: CUDA graph batch sizes
catalog.help: Exact batch sizes to record graphs for. Fewer sizes start faster and use less memory.

catalog.label: Pad batches to graph sizes
catalog.help: Round a batch up to the nearest recorded graph size so the graph can be used. Usually a net win for speed.

catalog.label: Attention backend
catalog.help: TRTLLM is the default and recommended kernel family. FLASHINFER disables KV block reuse; VANILLA is a slow reference implementation; FLASHINFER_STAR_ATTENTION is for star-attention long context.

catalog.label: torch.compile
catalog.help: Compile the model with torch.compile. Prototype: longer start-up, sometimes faster steps.

catalog.label: Piecewise CUDA graphs (prefill)
catalog.help: With torch.compile, also record CUDA graphs for prompt processing. Needs torch.compile on.

catalog.label: Inductor backend
catalog.help: With torch.compile, use the Inductor code generator. Needs torch.compile on.

catalog.label: Kernel autotuner
catalog.help: Time candidate kernels during start-up warm-up and keep the fastest. The image describes it as a debugging switch: turning it off can slow the engine noticeably.

catalog.label: Speculative method
catalog.help: MTP uses the model's own multi-token-prediction heads, Eagle uses an EAGLE-3 draft model, NGram guesses from the prompt, DraftTarget uses a small draft model, AUTO lets the engine pick.

catalog.label: Draft tokens per step
catalog.help: How many tokens the drafter proposes per step. Required for Eagle, NGram and DraftTarget; MTP takes it from the predict-layer count.

catalog.label: Draft model
catalog.help: Hugging Face repository (already in the local cache) or path of the draft model for Eagle and DraftTarget.

catalog.label: MTP predict layers
catalog.help: How many MTP heads to use for multi-token prediction (the model must have them). Default 1.

catalog.label: NGram match length
catalog.help: Longest run of tokens the NGram drafter searches for in earlier text. Required for NGram.

catalog.label: EAGLE-3 single engine
catalog.help: Run the EAGLE-3 drafter inside the same engine as the target model (default) instead of as a second engine.

catalog.label: Speculation batch limit
catalog.help: Stop speculating when more than this many requests run at once, because drafting stops paying off at large batches.

catalog.label: Speculative config (JSON)
catalog.help: Full speculative-decoding config as a JSON object that includes "decoding_type", for options the shortcut parameters do not cover. Cannot be combined with them.

catalog.label: Log level
catalog.help: Engine log verbosity. The console's start-up progress and fit checks read the info level, so lower levels hide them.

catalog.label: OTLP traces endpoint
catalog.help: Send OpenTelemetry traces to this URL (for example http://otel-collector:4317).

catalog.label: Iteration statistics (live metrics)
catalog.help: Collect per-step statistics (running and queued requests, KV cache use) that the /metrics endpoint serves. The engine default is off; the console turns it on so its metrics page works. Slight overhead.

catalog.label: Iteration statistics kept
catalog.help: How many of the newest per-step statistics the engine keeps between two reads of /metrics. The engine keeps 1000; the console keeps 100 when statistics are on, so one read stays far below the 512 KiB the console accepts per scrape.

catalog.label: Log every step
catalog.help: Write one log line per engine step with timings and batch sizes. Very chatty under load.

catalog.label: Extra engine options (JSON)
catalog.help: Additional top-level settings for the generated engine options file, as a JSON object. Unknown names make the engine refuse to start; settings that have their own parameter are rejected here.

catalog.label: Container image
catalog.help: Pinned TensorRT-LLM image tag override (never :latest). The catalog was read from 1.2.1; other releases can differ.

catalog.label: GPU layers
catalog.help: How many of the model's layers to keep in GPU memory: a number, 'all', or 'auto' (the engine picks what fits). Layers that stay out run on the CPU, which is far slower.

catalog.label: Automatic fit
catalog.help: When on, start-up shrinks every memory setting you left unset (context size, GPU layers) until the model fits in the free GPU memory. Settings you give explicitly are never changed.

catalog.label: Fit safety margin (MiB per GPU)
catalog.help: Free GPU memory the automatic fit must leave over on every GPU.

catalog.label: Smallest context the fit may pick
catalog.help: The automatic fit will not shrink the context below this many tokens.

catalog.label: KV cache on the GPU
catalog.help: Keep the KV cache (the running conversation memory) in GPU memory. Off moves it to host RAM, which saves GPU memory and slows every token.

catalog.label: KV cache type (keys)
catalog.help: Number format of the key half of the KV cache. q8_0 uses about half the memory of f16 with little quality loss.

catalog.label: KV cache type (values)
catalog.help: Number format of the value half of the KV cache. Anything other than f16, bf16 or f32 needs flash attention.

catalog.label: Full-size sliding-window cache
catalog.help: Keep a full-length KV cache even for sliding-window layers. Uses more memory; helps prompt reuse on some models.

catalog.label: Prompt cache size (MiB of RAM)
catalog.help: Host RAM the server may use to remember earlier prompts so repeated prefixes are not recomputed. -1 removes the limit and 0 turns the cache off.

catalog.label: Model loading mode
catalog.help: How the model file is read: mmap maps it (default), none reads it into RAM, mlock pins it in RAM, mmap+mlock does both, dio uses direct I/O.

catalog.label: All experts on the CPU
catalog.help: Keep every mixture-of-experts weight in host RAM while attention and shared layers stay on the GPU. Lets a very large MoE model run on a small GPU.

catalog.label: Experts of the first N layers on the CPU
catalog.help: Keep the expert weights of the first N layers in host RAM. A middle path between all on the GPU and --cpu-moe.

catalog.label: Tensor placement overrides
catalog.help: Comma-separated pattern=buffer rules that force named tensors onto a chosen device, for example exps=CPU. Very detailed control; the engine warns that CPU overrides combine badly with mmap.

catalog.label: Vision projector on the GPU
catalog.help: Run the image (multimodal projector) part of a vision model on the GPU.

catalog.label: Multi-GPU split mode
catalog.help: How a model is spread over several GPUs: none (one GPU), layer (default, layers and KV split in a pipeline), row, or tensor (experimental).

catalog.label: GPU split proportions
catalog.help: Share of the model each GPU gets, comma-separated, for example 3,1 puts three quarters on the first GPU.

catalog.label: Main GPU
catalog.help: Index of the GPU used when the split mode is none, and for intermediate results with the row split.

catalog.label: Devices to use
catalog.help: Comma-separated device names to offload to, or none to keep everything on the CPU. Run with --list-devices to see names.

catalog.label: Context size (tokens)
catalog.help: Total tokens of conversation memory the server allocates; 0 uses the model's trained maximum. With several slots the budget is shared between them.

catalog.label: RoPE scaling method
catalog.help: How positions are stretched to reach a context longer than the model was trained on: none, linear or yarn.

catalog.label: RoPE scale factor
catalog.help: Context expansion factor: 4 stretches a 32k-trained model towards 128k.

catalog.label: RoPE base frequency
catalog.help: Base frequency for NTK-aware scaling; the default is read from the model.

catalog.label: YaRN original context
catalog.help: The context length the model was trained on, for YaRN scaling; 0 uses the value stored in the model.

catalog.label: Context shift
catalog.help: When a conversation outgrows its slot, drop the oldest tokens and keep going instead of stopping.

catalog.label: Minimum tokens per image
catalog.help: Lower bound of tokens one image takes, for vision models with dynamic resolution; the default is read from the model.

catalog.label: Maximum tokens per image
catalog.help: Upper bound of tokens one image takes, for vision models with dynamic resolution; the default is read from the model.

catalog.label: Vision projector file
catalog.help: Path of the multimodal projector GGUF, inside the model folder (/models/<file>), for vision models.

catalog.label: LoRA adapters
catalog.help: Comma-separated LoRA adapter GGUF files inside the model folder (/models/<file>), applied on top of the model.

catalog.label: LoRA adapters with scales
catalog.help: Comma-separated file:scale pairs, for example /models/a.gguf:0.5, applied on top of the model.

catalog.label: Load LoRA without applying
catalog.help: Load the adapters but leave them switched off until a request turns them on.

catalog.label: Override model metadata
catalog.help: Comma-separated KEY=TYPE:VALUE entries (types int, float, bool, str) that replace metadata stored in the model file.

catalog.label: Slots (parallel requests)
catalog.help: Number of conversations served at the same time. -1 lets the engine pick (4 slots sharing one KV buffer).

catalog.label: Unified KV buffer
catalog.help: Let all slots share one KV buffer instead of splitting the context evenly; on by default only when the slot count is auto.

catalog.label: Continuous batching
catalog.help: Let new requests join a batch that is already running instead of waiting for it to finish.

catalog.label: Prompt caching
catalog.help: Reuse the part of a slot's earlier prompt that matches the new request so only the new part is processed.

catalog.label: Prompt reuse chunk size
catalog.help: Minimum length of a matching chunk that may be reused from the cache by shifting it; 0 turns this off.

catalog.label: Save idle slots to the prompt cache
catalog.help: When a new task starts, store the idle slots' conversations in the prompt cache and free them. Needs the prompt cache.

catalog.label: Slot prompt similarity
catalog.help: How closely a request must match a slot's earlier prompt for that slot to be reused; 0 disables the check.

catalog.label: Context checkpoints per slot
catalog.help: Maximum snapshots of a conversation kept per slot, used to rewind models that cannot drop recent tokens.

catalog.label: Sleep after idle (s)
catalog.help: Seconds without requests after which the server sleeps and frees the model; -1 turns it off.

catalog.label: Warm-up run
catalog.help: Run one empty generation at start-up so the first real request is not slow.

catalog.label: Flash attention
catalog.help: Use the memory-efficient attention kernels: on, off, or auto (default; on whenever the GPU backend supports the model).

catalog.label: CPU threads
catalog.help: Threads used while generating tokens on the CPU; -1 picks automatically. Only matters when layers run on the CPU.

catalog.label: CPU threads (prompt processing)
catalog.help: Threads used while processing prompts; by default the same as threads.

catalog.label: Logical batch size
catalog.help: Largest number of tokens handed to the model in one step. Larger speeds up long prompts and uses more memory.

catalog.label: Physical batch size
catalog.help: Largest number of tokens the GPU computes at once; sets the size of the compute buffers.

catalog.label: NUMA strategy
catalog.help: Placement hint for multi-socket CPUs: distribute, isolate or numactl. Leave unset on single-socket machines.

catalog.label: Jinja chat templates
catalog.help: Use the full chat template engine. Needed for tool calls and for splitting reasoning from the answer.

catalog.label: Built-in chat template
catalog.help: Name of a built-in template (for example chatml or llama3) or an inline Jinja template; replaces the one stored in the model.

catalog.label: Custom chat template (Jinja)
catalog.help: Full Jinja template text. The console writes it to a file inside the container; it replaces the model's own template.

catalog.label: Chat template arguments (JSON)
catalog.help: Extra arguments handed to the template for every request, for example {"enable_thinking": false}.

catalog.label: Reasoning mode
catalog.help: Turn the model's thinking on, off, or auto (detect from the chat template).

catalog.label: Reasoning output format
catalog.help: Where thinking text goes: none leaves it in the answer, deepseek puts it in reasoning_content, deepseek-legacy does both.

catalog.label: Reasoning budget (tokens)
catalog.help: Cap on thinking tokens: -1 unlimited, 0 ends thinking immediately, a positive number is the budget.

catalog.label: Keep reasoning in the history
catalog.help: Keep earlier thinking in the conversation history for templates that support it, not only in the latest message.

catalog.label: Skip chat output parsing
catalog.help: Return everything, including reasoning and tool calls, as plain content.

catalog.label: Prefill the assistant reply
catalog.help: When the last message is from the assistant, continue it instead of treating it as a finished message.

catalog.label: Speculative decoding type
catalog.help: How draft tokens are produced: none, a draft model (draft-simple, draft-eagle3, draft-dflash), the model's own MTP layers (draft-mtp), or n-gram lookup from the context.

catalog.label: Draft model file
catalog.help: Path of the draft model GGUF, inside the model folder (/models/<file>).

catalog.label: Draft tokens per step (max)
catalog.help: Most tokens the draft proposes before the main model checks them.

catalog.label: Draft tokens per step (min)
catalog.help: Fewest draft tokens worth checking; shorter drafts are skipped.

catalog.label: Draft confidence floor
catalog.help: Stop drafting when the draft model's confidence in the next token falls below this probability.

catalog.label: Draft model GPU layers
catalog.help: How many layers of the draft model go to the GPU: a number, 'all' or 'auto'.

catalog.label: Extra model names
catalog.help: Extra names the API answers to. The console always serves its own name first.

catalog.label: API key
catalog.help: Require this key (sent as a Bearer token) on the API. Passed through the LLAMA_API_KEY environment variable, not the command line. The metrics page then needs the key too.

catalog.label: Allowed browser origins
catalog.help: Which web pages may call the API from a browser. The console sets localhost; the engine's own default (*) lets any website read answers from a loopback port.

catalog.label: Built-in web page
catalog.help: Serve llama.cpp's own chat page on the same port.

catalog.label: Slots monitoring endpoint
catalog.help: Expose /slots, which lists what each slot is doing.

catalog.label: Server read/write timeout (s)
catalog.help: Seconds the HTTP server waits on a stalled connection.

catalog.label: Log verbosity
catalog.help: How much the server logs: 0 generic, 1 errors, 2 warnings, 3 info, 4 trace, 5 debug.

catalog.label: Embeddings-only server
catalog.help: Serve only the embeddings endpoint; use with a dedicated embedding model.

catalog.label: Embedding pooling
catalog.help: How token vectors are combined into one embedding; the model's own default is used when unset.

catalog.label: Reranking endpoint
catalog.help: Enable the reranking endpoint; use with a reranker model.

catalog.label: Default temperature
catalog.help: Randomness of sampling when a request does not set it: low is focused, high is varied.

catalog.label: Default top-k
catalog.help: Sample only from the k most likely tokens when a request does not set it; 0 turns it off.

catalog.label: Default top-p
catalog.help: Sample only from the smallest set of tokens whose probabilities add up to p; 1.0 turns it off.

catalog.label: Default min-p
catalog.help: Drop tokens less likely than p times the best token; 0 turns it off.

catalog.label: Default repeat penalty
catalog.help: Penalty for tokens that appeared in the recent text; 1.0 turns it off.

catalog.label: Default presence penalty
catalog.help: Flat penalty for any token that has already appeared; 0 turns it off.

catalog.label: Default frequency penalty
catalog.help: Penalty that grows with how often a token has already appeared; 0 turns it off.

catalog.label: Random seed
catalog.help: Fixed seed for repeatable sampling; -1 picks a random one.

catalog.label: Context length (tokens)
catalog.help: Tokens of conversation memory for each request slot. 0 lets Ollama choose from the GPU memory: 4k below 24 GiB, 32k from 24 GiB, 256k from 48 GiB.

catalog.label: Keep-alive time
catalog.help: How long an idle model stays loaded: 5m, 24h, a number of seconds, 0 to unload at once, or -1 to keep it forever.

catalog.label: Models kept loaded
catalog.help: Most models that stay loaded at once, per GPU. 0 lets Ollama decide (3 per GPU, or 3 for CPU-only).

catalog.label: KV cache type
catalog.help: Number format of the KV cache for every model: f16 (default), q8_0 (about half the memory) or q4_0 (about a quarter). The quantized types need flash attention.

catalog.label: Reserved GPU memory (bytes per GPU)
catalog.help: Memory Ollama leaves free on each GPU for other programs.

catalog.label: llama.cpp automatic fit
catalog.help: Let the llama.cpp engine inside Ollama shrink unset memory options so the model fits (on or off).

catalog.label: Fit safety margin (MiB per GPU)
catalog.help: Free GPU memory the llama.cpp automatic fit leaves over on each GPU.

catalog.label: Parallel requests per model
catalog.help: How many requests one loaded model answers at the same time. The context memory is multiplied by this number.

catalog.label: Request queue length
catalog.help: Most requests that may wait; further requests are refused with an error.

catalog.label: Model load timeout
catalog.help: How long a model load may stall before Ollama gives up, for example 5m or 30m.

catalog.label: Spread models over all GPUs
catalog.help: Always split a model across every GPU. By default Ollama uses as few GPUs as the model needs.

catalog.label: Flash attention
catalog.help: Force flash attention on (true) or off (false). Unset lets Ollama decide for each model.

catalog.label: Compute library
catalog.help: Choose the compute library instead of auto-detection. The pinned image has cuda_v12, cuda_v13 and vulkan.

catalog.label: Use integrated GPUs
catalog.help: Let Ollama use integrated graphics as well. Only 'on' is sent; 'off' leaves the variable unset.

catalog.label: Extra browser origins
catalog.help: Web origins allowed to call the API from a browser, added to the built-in list (localhost and a few desktop-app origins).

catalog.label: Model transfer streams
catalog.help: Parallel streams for pulling and pushing safetensors models. No effect here: the store is read-only and the engine is offline.

catalog.label: Debug logging
catalog.help: Show additional debug information in the engine log.
